verdict: Meta has been dark three days; lead generation is currently paused.
narrative: Your Meta ads stopped delivering on August 6th and have run at $0 spend and zero leads for three consecutive days — since all 78 leads this period came from Meta, that means active lead generation is currently at a standstill. Before the channel went dark, cost per lead had already risen 11.3% week-over-week, signaling some efficiency loss in delivery. Restoring Meta delivery is the immediate priority and is being worked on now. Separately, 57 contacts have arrived in your pipeline this period but zero have been converted into tracked opportunities, which means leads are coming in but not being captured downstream — that intake process is being corrected alongside the ad restoration. Once Meta is back on, you should expect lead volume to resume; the 28-day baseline of $24.20 cost per lead gives us a clear efficiency target to return to.
